notes_for_editor: Dates for 1931, 1961 and registration agree across sources. Unresolved: the register says the 1961 tower was removed in 1981, while the Fire Lookout Association and Willhite say destroyed; the story reports both. The record's name Cedar Point (City) is kept; the 1942 report and Willhite call the site City Lookout (Lookout Mountain), which could be added as an alias, but no correction is filed because the record is not wrong. The register names Irene Potter as nominator; a search did not confirm any link, so she is left out. Forest Lookouts index lists a 'Seattle Filter Center' label with no explanation; the story does not use it. Access is closed, so the story gives no route. Used 1 WebSearch and 5 page reads.
